verdict.rationale: Requesty's Prompt Library lets users store reusable configurations (messages, model, parameters, output formats) that API requests reference by prompt_id, and it documents version tracking with full diffs. That covers versioning and review for the closest thing this gateway has to an automation artifact. Missing for 10: documented rollback/restore to a prior version, versioning of routing configs (fallback/load-balancing policies), any review/approval workflow beyond diffs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: track versions with full diffs, organize with tags, and reference prompts in any API request with a single prompt_id
